name: Forcibly Asocial — Days of Void
source:
After a surreal, bizarre dream, I wake up to discover that the world is not as I remember it any more.
Everything is surrounded by an unnatural, illogical sensation of comfort along with a rational, obscure feeling of discomfort.

Will I be able to figure what’s going on? Will I ever find the roots behind this perplexing, twisted mystery?
